title: 第1368章 天骄聚首第1367章 只要现世报
slug: 太古神墟第1974章药园小酌
content_zh:
玲珑塔五十倍时间加速域一隅，静谧无声，光阴飞速流逝。
赢天盘膝端坐，条条道纹锁链紧锁其身。
可纵然身困枷锁，他依旧神色恬淡安然，眉眼平和无波。
当年大劫落幕后不久，落尘便将他从曜日领域移出，安置在这片时间加速之中。
落尘意在借玲珑塔的时间流速，快速催发赢天神魂深处潜藏的梦之力与光明之力。
希望能以双力涤荡其邪神本源，寻回其本心。
赢天这这一坐，便是整整十五年。
外界十五载光阴，换算成玲珑塔五十倍流速，已将近八百年漫长岁月。
八百载孤寂枯坐，赢天始终维持盘膝姿态，纹丝未动。
这一日，静谧的空间微泛涟漪，落尘的身形悄然浮现。
他眉眼带笑，语气温和亲切：
“二师兄，别来无恙？一向可好？”
赢天缓缓睁眼眸，看向落尘无悲无喜，轻轻摇头：
“落尘，你的苦心，恐怕终究是白费了。”
他脸上带着苦笑：
“哈哈，这些岁月来，我也曾静待蜕变。
我主动配合魇墟残魂觉醒的梦之力、光明之力，清除我神魂深处的邪神本源。
可这近千年的淬炼，那根植神魂深处的邪恶本源，根本无法根除。”
“早在五百年前，我便察觉，自身善念与恶念各占五成。
自那之后，无论我如何用功，善念都无法再增益，恶念亦无法消减。

二者分庭抗礼，始终僵持不变。”
“真的？”
落尘没有失望，眼底反而漾起欣喜：
“二师兄，你本是邪神，如今能明晰善恶，便是千载难逢的最大突破！
世人皆以为邪神生来纯粹至恶，可你如今已然坐拥半数善念。
这已是天大的幸事，可喜可贺！”
话音未落，落尘指尖轻轻一弹。
嗤啦数声轻响，那些禁锢赢天的道纹锁链寸寸消融。
枷锁尽去，赢天身躯微微一滞，眸中掠过一丝诧异：
“你这般轻易便放我自由？我的邪念根深蒂固，甚至不受控制。
你就不怕我再度……”
话到一半，后面被他咽回。
他心底自知，作为邪神，他甚至可无惧诸天万界任何人。可在落尘面前，根本翻不起半分风浪，落尘不会怕。
content_en:
A corner of Linglong Tower's Fifty Times Time Acceleration Domain is silent and time flies by.
Yingtian sat cross-legged, with chains locked tightly around his body.
But even though he was trapped in shackles, he still looked calm and calm, and his eyebrows were calm and unruffled.
Shortly after the great catastrophe ended, Luochen removed him from the Sunlight Realm and placed him in this accelerated time.
The purpose of Luochen is to use the time flow speed of Linglong Tower to quickly activate the power of dreams and light hidden deep in Yingtian's soul.
I hope that I can use my two powers to cleanse the origin of the evil god and find his true heart.
Yingtian has been sitting here for fifteen years.
Fifteen years in the outside world, converted into fifty times the flow rate of Linglong Tower, has been nearly eight hundred years.
After sitting in solitude for eight hundred years, Yingtian always maintained a cross-legged posture without moving at all.
On this day, the quiet space rippled slightly, and Luochen's figure quietly emerged.
He had a smile on his face and a gentle and friendly tone:
"Second Senior Brother, are you okay? Are you always doing well?"
Yingtian slowly opened his eyes, looked at Luochen without sadness or joy, and shook his head gently:
"Luochen, I'm afraid all your hard work will be in vain after all."
He had a wry smile on his face:
"Haha, over the years, I have been waiting for transformation.
I took the initiative to cooperate with the power of dreams and the power of light awakened by the remnant soul of Nightmare Ruins to eliminate the origin of the evil god deep in my soul.
But after nearly a thousand years of tempering, the evil origin deeply rooted in the soul cannot be eradicated at all. "
"As early as five hundred years ago, I realized that my good thoughts and evil thoughts accounted for 50% each.
From then on, no matter how hard I worked, my good thoughts could no longer be increased, and my evil thoughts could not be reduced.
The two fought against each other and remained in a stalemate. "
"Really?"
Luochen was not disappointed, instead his eyes filled with joy:
"Second Senior Brother, you were originally an evil god, but now that you can understand good and evil, this is the greatest breakthrough that has ever happened in a lifetime!
Everyone in the world thinks that evil gods are born pure and evil, but now you already have half of your good thoughts.
This is a great blessing, and congratulations! "
Before he finished speaking, Luochen flicked his fingertips.
With a few soft chirps, the Taoist chains that imprisoned Yingtian melted inch by inch.
After the shackles were removed, Yingtian's body stagnated slightly, and a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes:
"You let me go so easily? My evil thoughts are so deep-rooted that I can't even control them.
Aren’t you afraid that I will…”
Halfway through the words, he swallowed back the rest.
He knew in his heart that as an evil god, he was not afraid of anyone in the world. But in front of Luochen, there is no way he can survive the storm, and Luochen won't be afraid.
